everest: Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level, with a summit elevation of 8,849 meters. It lies on the border between Nepal and China. Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay made the first confirmed ascent on May 29, 1953. The mountain is known as Sagarmatha in Nepal and Chomolungma in Tibet. Most climbers attempt the summit in May, when the weather is most stable.
photosynthesis: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert light energy into chemical energy. It takes place mainly in the chloroplasts of leaf cells. Chlorophyll, the green pigment in chloroplasts, absorbs mostly red and blue light. The process uses carbon dioxide and water and releases oxygen as a byproduct. The glucose produced is used by the plant for growth and energy storage.
marathon: The marathon is a long-distance race with an official distance of 42.195 kilometers. The distance was standardized in 1921. The event was part of the first modern Olympic Games in Athens in 1896. The women's marathon was added to the Olympic program in 1984. Eliud Kipchoge of Kenya ran a marathon in under two hours in Vienna in 2019, although the run did not count as an official world record.
harborview: The Harborview City Council approved a new transit plan on March 3. The plan adds 12 bus routes and extends light rail service to the airport. Construction is expected to cost $240 million and take four years. Council member Priya Raman said the project will not raise property taxes. Funding will come from a state grant and a 0.5% sales tax approved by voters last November.
orion_press: Orion Labs released its Vega 3 battery on September 9. The battery stores 85 kilowatt-hours and charges to 80% in 18 minutes. Chief Technology Officer Marcus Feld said production will begin at the company's Austin plant.
orion_filing: Orion Labs was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Denver. The company employs about 3,100 people. In its latest filing, Orion Labs reported that the Vega 3 battery will cost $9,400.
